j-soul.bio: Toronto rapper and R&B artist J-Soul emerged from the city's west end and signed with Cash Money Records after building momentum around melodic records including Slow Wine and Toronto Plaza Hotel.

junny.bio: Korean-Canadian singer-songwriter and producer JUNNY grew up in Vancouver before relocating to South Korea, where his smooth R&B-pop work expanded into songwriting for major K-pop artists including NCT, IU and Baekhyun.

josh martinez.bio: Canadian alternative hip-hop artist Josh Martinez is a rapper, producer and label founder whose independent career grew through Halifax and Vancouver and includes solo work as well as the duo The Chicharones.

k-rec.bio: Vancouver producer and DJ K-Rec, born Kent Stephany, is a longtime figure in Canadian underground hip-hop whose sample-driven production and turntablism have connected generations of West Coast rap artists.
